1.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

2.web: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
2.asv: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

3.web: Don’t put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help.
3.asv: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

4.web: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
4.asv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.

5.web: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
5.asv: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:

6.web: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
6.asv: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

7.web: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
7.asv: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

8.web: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
8.asv: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

9.web: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.
9.asv: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

10.web: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
10.asv: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
